scope: Sensitivity analysis using a client-TPOT-derived decode proxy; not calibrated GPU/WAN performance.

provenance.target_loads: Concurrent requests, not utilization: 1/8/32 are existing TPOT batch grid points; interpreting them as load levels is a sensitivity assumption.
provenance.bandwidth: Existing cross_domain.json uses 125000 bytes/ms (1 Gbit/s); 0.1x/1x/10x are sensitivity levels, NOT measured WAN bandwidth.
provenance.latency: 10 ms one-way and local serialization rate reuse network.py/cross_domain.json illustrative assumptions.
provenance.decode: Nearest batch and nearest average context p50 from measured-client-derived TPOT grid; using it as a batch service time is an unvalidated estimate.
provenance.prefill_and_replay: Existing latency.py affine example values; no calibrated batch-level prefill or cached-prefix rebuild profile available.
provenance.kv: 57344 bytes/token reused from existing scenario; assumed layout, not verified against current model tensor storage. KV blocks rounded by existing engine.
provenance.wire: uint32 token bytes=4 from runtime contract; control=256 and output=64 are existing illustrative constants.
provenance.workload: Synthetic seeded output lengths, source concurrency, arrivals, 200 ms trigger and 100000 ms horizon are experimental design assumptions; no measured workload claim.
provenance.power: Power traces exist, but no validated state-dependent compute/replay/copy power model is connected; no energy conclusions.
